text: Proactive measures for motivating teams include. <break time="0.8s" /> Promotions and salary increases contingent upon teamwork success. <break time="0.8s" /> In addition it is important. <break time="0.8s" /> To continue to sweeten the pot. <break time="0.8s" /> So to speak. <break time="0.8s" /> All new hires would be evaluated. <break time="0.8s" /> On a set of personality characteristics. <break time="0.8s" /> Held in as high regard as education, experience, and technical competence. <break time="0.8s" /> If teams are going to be the measure of success. <break time="0.8s" /> In the organization. <break time="0.8s" /> The existing paradigm of the individual. <break time="0.8s" /> Has to be eliminated. <break time="0.8s" /> I worked in one company that had a number of prima donnas in key areas. <break time="0.8s" /> I could never understand. <break time="0.8s" /> Why these people were kept on the payroll. <break time="0.8s" /> No matter what technical skills these people had they were frequently mentioned as barriers. <break time="0.8s" /> That, instead of being removed. <break time="0.8s" /> Were worked around. <break time="0.8s" /> People complained. <break time="0.8s" /> About the friction occurring in meetings with these people. <break time="0.8s" /> Where business issues were supposed to be resolved. <break time="0.8s" /> Instead what little teamwork might have evolved. <break time="0.8s" /> Was never given a chance. <break time="0.8s" /> A team centered culture. <break time="0.8s" /> Cannot even begin to take shape. <break time="0.8s" /> With individuals such as these.
